verdict.rationale: Postmark's Domains API documents verification endpoints for DKIM, Return-Path and SPF, plus DKIM key rotation, so domain authentication can be checked programmatically. Custom sending domains and sender-signature management are also documented. DMARC appears only as a paid per-domain monitoring add-on, not as record generation, and no independent corroboration is present. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that exact SPF/DKIM DNS record values are generated and returned, DMARC record generation, documented verification-status fields in API responses, hands-on corroboration.
